name: Warm plate
intro: Something warm, something cold, something sharp, on one plate. Ground lamb makes it dinner; the finish makes it different each time.
season_anchor: Ground lamb, browned with garlic and chile flakes

variations.ingredients: Sweet and sour: yogurt + pomegranate + dates
variations.context: The default. Yogurt under everything, pomegranate and dates over it.
A spoonful of the jar on the lamb, feta crumbled over, greens on the side.

variations.ingredients: Green and bright: arugula + lemon + chile oil
variations.context: A big pile of greens, lemon squeezed hard, warm chile-garlic oil over the lamb.

finish: Brown all the lamb at once, hard, in a dry pan — let it sit until it crusts before you break it up — then add a grated garlic clove and a pinch of chile flakes for the last minute. Half goes on tonight's plate; the rest keeps four days for a second plate, toast, or the hash. Build each plate in layers: rice, warm squash and lamb, then the finish on top.
